   483	  // Use a regular function instead of an arrow function to facilitate binding to the resolver.
   484	  const resolve = function resolve<T extends object>(
   485	    this: BuildResolver<any>,
   486	    container: AwilixContainer<T>,
   487	  ) {
   488	    // Because the container holds a global reolutionMode we need to determine it in the proper order of precedence:
   489	    // resolver -> container -> default value
   490	    const injectionMode =
   491	      this.injectionMode ||
   492	      container.options.injectionMode ||
   493	      InjectionMode.PROXY
   494	
   495	    if (injectionMode !== InjectionMode.CLASSIC) {
   496	      // If we have a custom injector, we need to wrap the cradle.
   497	      const cradle = this.injector
   498	        ? createInjectorProxy(container, this.injector)
   499	        : container.cradle
   500	
   501	      // Return the target injected with the cradle
   502	      return fn(cradle)
   503	    }
   504	
   505	    // We have dependencies so we need to resolve them manually
   506	    if (dependencies.length > 0) {
   507	      const resolve = this.injector
   508	        ? wrapWithLocals(container, this.injector(container))
   509	        : container.resolve
   510	
   511	      const children = dependencies.map((p) =>
   512	        resolve(p.name, { allowUnregistered: p.optional }),
   513	      )
   514	      return fn(...children)
   515	    }
   516	
   517	    return fn()
   518	  }
   519	
   520	  // Expose the parsed dependencies so initialization can build a dependency graph.
   521	  ;(resolve as any).dependencies = dependencies
   522	
   523	  return resolve
